newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Telebras EPADR raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Telebras EPADR raised.

text.p: -- Morgan Stanley said it raised its earnings estimates for Brazilian telecom firm Telebras's ADRs to $8.18 from $7.75 for 1996 and to $9.65 from $9.46 for 1997.
-- "These changes reflect Morgan Stanley's improved inflation oulook for Brazil as well as Telebras' solid performance so far this year," Morgan Stanley's analyst Luiz Carvalho said in a report.
-- Morgan Stanley also said it was maintaining its strong buy rating on Telebras.

-- "Despite the stock's recent weakness, we continue to believe that Telebras is the most attractive telecom company in Latin America," the report said, noting Telebras offers strong projected earnings growth averaging over 18.9 percent over the next five years.
-- It also noted the stock's recent underperformance is not related to any deterioration of the company's fundamentals.
-- "We believe that concerns related to a suspended 1990 stock offer are overdone," it said.

-- Last week a court decided to back a Telebras subscriptiom of 13.4 billion shares, made in 1990. The subscription was blocked by a federal court which called for an investigation based on allegations that the share price was below the firm's value.
-- Although the share issue still depends on a final court ruling, investors have been concerned about the effects of the subscription on the company's stock price.
-- Morgan Stanley said that even in the worst case scenario, Telebras shares would be dilluted by no more than 4.3 percent.

-- The report also said Morgan Stanley's new forecast for Brazil's inflation is 11 percent for 1996 and 7.4 percent for 1997. Its previous estimates were 13.4 percent for 1996 and 14.8 percent for next year.
-- Telebras preferred traded at 74.90 reais, up 1.49 percent, at 1220 local/1420 GMT on the Sao Paulo bourse.
